A '''planet''' in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] was neutral for most of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but eventually began to welcome ambassadors from both the Empire and the Republic.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Choices and Consequences}}</ref>
